summary.tldr: Lets people bypass certain technological protection measures on lawfully obtained software to make it work with other programs, devices or components.
what_it_does: Allows people to bypass a technological protection measure on a lawfully obtained computer program to learn how to make it interoperable with other software, devices or components.
Allows people to bypass that measure to make the program, or a device that contains it, interoperable with other software, devices or components.
Allows a person who got that information to share it with someone else for the same interoperability purpose.
Limits the use of the technology, device, component or information to interoperability work only.
Denies the exception if the person also does an act that infringes copyright, and in one case if they break another federal or provincial law.
summary.background: The bill changes subsection 41.12 of the Copyright Act. That section deals with when someone may circumvent a technological protection measure.
